body:
I used to tell the same thing to my friends, but they love to convince themselves that the fabric is better just because it costs more, even though it feels exactly the same. I’ve met many people in my life who automatically assume something is higher quality simply because it’s more expensive, when in reality, price often reflects branding, platform fees, and marketing rather than actual quality. Probably, Myntra charges more from the seller, which is why they had to increase the price, so it doesn’t necessarily mean the product itself is better.

At the end of the day, it depends on people’s interests. If they have the money and enjoy spending it on their hobbies and preferences, then that’s fine. Everyone has the freedom to live their lives by their own choice.

body:
Don’t worry, this happens with many creators. Photos usually approve easily, but videos have stricter checks.
Make sure:
• Video is clear, vertical & original
• Product is clearly visible (no collage / screen recording)
• No background music with copyright
• Proper lighting & steady video

Approval can also take time, so wait a bit and try uploading again. Hope this helps 😊

	4.	You’ll now see the video description, including any links or text provided by the creator.
